post.text:
Justice Rachel Sussock was sworn in as a Judge of Te Koti Matua - High Court at the Auckland High Court on Monday 8 June. The ceremony was presided over by the Chief Justice.

Guests were welcomed to the Court with a waiata by the Auckland High Court Waiata Ropu, and mihi whakatau from Justice Whata.

Speeches were given by Deputy Solicitor-General Anthea Williams on behalf of the Government, and David Campbell, President of the New Zealand Law Society, on behalf of the profession.

Justice Sussock will sit in Auckland. sen.nz/b5hx5q
